response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY s.transref, tr.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, s.shortintrt AS shortintrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg), gavg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS grp_avg FROM g GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT t.transref, t.ordertypedist, t.avg_short, t.avg_opt, t.avg_short / NULLIF(gavg.grp_avg, 0) AS short_ratio FROM t LEFT JOIN gavg ON t.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gavg.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
